transcript:
[00:00] Nadia: These are preliminary results: eleven of twenty participants improved. There is no control group.
[00:10] Leo: So the treatment is proven effective?
[00:20] Nadia: No. We cannot infer efficacy or causation from this study.
[00:30] Marta: I already removed names from the working dataset.
[00:40] Nadia: Good. Publication still needs ethics approval. Names removed does not make consent unnecessary.
[00:50] Leo: I will prepare the limitations section by September3.
[01:00] Marta: I suggested we publish September4, but I withdraw it. No publication date is agreed.
[01:10] Nadia: I can review Leo's section, though I cannot commit to a review date.
[01:20] Leo: The next sample size might be50 or80.
[01:30] Nadia: Neither is approved; funding for another study is also unresolved.
